supersedes: trades-only-btcusdt-spot-v2 (FAIL at validation; test window unused). New hypothesis, not a retune: intraday taker trading showed about 0 bp gross edge against about 24 bp round-trip cost.
hypothesis: Simple daily long/flat rules on BTCUSDT (trend, momentum, breakout, mean reversion) earn a better risk-adjusted return than buy-and-hold after full costs, because each trade spans days to months and costs are small relative to the move.
position_scope: long or flat, fully invested when long, no leverage, no shorting, paper research only

data_source.checksum: every zip verified against its .CHECKSUM (sha256) before use
data_source.timestamp_unit: milliseconds before 2025, microseconds from 2025; the runner normalises to UTC days
data_source.gaps: a missing day inside a segment is an error, not filled

clock.signal: computed from daily closes up to and including day d-1
clock.execution: position for day d is taken at the open of day d
clock.daily_return: open(d+1) / open(d) - 1 while long, 0 while flat
clock.warmup: features may use closes before a segment start (past data only); 2017-08 to 2017-12 is warm-up only

configurations.rule: long while close > simple moving average of the last N closes
long while close / close L days earlier - 1 > 0
enter when close > max of the previous N closes; exit when close < min of the previous floor(N/2) closes
enter when close / previous close - 1 <= -X; hold H days, then flat; a new trigger while long restarts the H-day count

parameter_searches_beyond_this_grid: none; any new rule or parameter is a new spec version

execution_and_costs.applied: equity is multiplied by (1 - 0.0012) on every entry and every exit
execution_and_costs.fee_sensitivity_info_only: same results with fee 0.00075/side are reported but never used for selection or pass/fail

chronological_split.segments: train [start, validation_start), validation [validation_start, test_start), test [test_start, end)
chronological_split.no_cross_segment_positions: every segment starts flat and any open position is closed at the segment end (the open of the first day after it), with exit cost
chronological_split.embargo_rule: no entry on the first day of validation or test; signals may use earlier closes

metrics: annualised Sharpe of daily net returns (mean/std * sqrt(365))
max drawdown of the equity curve

selection.metric: annualised Sharpe of daily net returns
selection.tie_break: higher validation total net return, then configuration order above
selection.gate_to_run_test: the selected configuration must have validation total net return > 0 and validation Sharpe > buy-and-hold validation Sharpe; otherwise verdict fail and the test is not run
selection.report_all_configurations: all 15 train and validation results are reported

baselines: buy_and_hold (enter at the segment's first open, exit at its end, with costs)

test_evaluation.evaluates: the single validation-selected configuration plus baselines on the test segment
test_evaluation.enforcement: runner refuses a second test run (exclusive marker file next to the data)

all_required: test max drawdown < buy-and-hold test max drawdown
pass_criteria.otherwise: fail; report it and stop this hypothesis

known_limits: Daily data gives few independent trades; even a pass is weak statistical evidence.
The researcher's prior knowledge of BTC price history (2018-2026) is outside contamination that no split can remove.
Next-open fills ignore slippage beyond the 2 bp/side adjustment; fine for BTCUSDT spot at research size, not proof of live capacity.
A pass is not a profitability claim for live trading; it only says the rule beat buy-and-hold on one out-of-sample period.
